svg.title: FlashDrop pairing flow
svg.desc: FlashDrop pairing flow (design direction): scan a QR code, pair devices peer-to-peer over Wi-Fi / local network, then transfer. Technology direction: Flutter, Dart, Cross-platform architecture, P2P / Wi-Fi transfer, QR-based pairing. The QR code on this card opens https://github.com/thedenilsonpinto.
